description: This file defines the SessionManager class in Drupal, which manages user sessions by extending Symfony's NativeSessionStorage. It includes methods for starting, saving, regenerating, and destroying sessions, and integrates Drupal-specific session handling features.

classes.name: SessionManager
classes.description: A class that manages user sessions in Drupal, extending Symfony's NativeSessionStorage and adding Drupal-specific session handling logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new SessionManager instance with dependencies injected.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the session if not already started, with lazy loading support.

methods.name: startNow
methods.description: Forcibly starts a PHP session, restoring session data if lazy loading was used.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the session data, handling deprecation warnings for direct $_SESSION modifications.

methods.name: regenerate
methods.description: Regenerates the session ID, destroying the old session if needed.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a session record from the database for a given user ID.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the current session and unsets session cookies.

methods.name: isCli
methods.description: Checks if the current PHP process is running on CLI.

methods.name: isSessionObsolete
methods.description: Determines if the session contains user data or is obsolete.

methods.name: getSessionDataMask
methods.description: Returns a map indicating which session keys contain user data.
